tools.description: Create a list in an explicit account. Colors use opaque #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBFF. Emblems are Reminders icon names. WRITE_APPLIED includes the saved ID if subsequent automation or enrichment fails; do not retry creation blindly.
tools.name: lists_create

tools.description: Update list name, color or emblem. Omitted values are unchanged; nulls and empty patches are invalid. Emblem writes or response enrichment can fail after stored fields are saved. WRITE_APPLIED includes the saved ID; refetch before retrying.
tools.name: lists_update

tools.description: Delete a list. Nonempty lists require allowNonEmpty=true, which also deletes their reminders. The emptiness check does not lock out concurrent external edits.
tools.name: lists_delete

tools.description: Show a reminder in Reminders. Changes the application UI, not reminder data.
tools.name: reminders_show

tools.description: Show a list in Reminders. Changes the application UI, not list data.
tools.name: lists_show

tools.description: Create an incomplete reminder. Specify listId or use the application's default list. Optional values must be omitted, not null. Timed/all-day due dates are exclusive; allDayStartDate is currently unsupported. Each alarm needs exactly one trigger; relative alarms require a start date. A retry can create duplicates. A WRITE_APPLIED error means the save succeeded but later automation or response enrichment failed; refetch using the reported ID.
tools.name: reminders_create

tools.description: Patch a reminder by ID. Omitted fields are unchanged; null is invalid. At least one change is required. clearFields removes optional values; [] alone is not a change. Do not set and clear a property together, or combine completed and completionDate changes. alarms replaces all alerts; [] removes them. Dates can affect alerts. A WRITE_APPLIED error means the save succeeded but later automation or response enrichment failed; refetch before retrying.
tools.name: reminders_update

tools.description: Delete one reminder. Missing IDs return a NOT_FOUND tool error. Refetch before retrying after uncertain failures.
tools.name: reminders_delete

tools.description: Read an account by identifier; returns null when it has no accessible reminder lists or is absent.
tools.name: accounts_get

tools.description: Read accounts with accessible reminder lists, ordered by identifier.
tools.name: accounts_list

tools.description: Read a list with its icon and container reference; absent identifiers return null. Reminders automation metadata is required for a complete result.
tools.name: lists_get

tools.description: Read the accessible default list and its account; unavailable defaults return null.
tools.name: defaults_get

tools.description: Count all reminders per accessible list, optionally restricted to listId. Counts overlap and include completed items except overdue.
tools.name: lists_summary

tools.description: Read lists filtered by name, account IDs, editability, and subscription. Use filter for criteria or the legacy flat inputs, never both. orderBy.direction selects name ordering; do not combine it with sort. Filters intersect. Pagination uses limit and an opaque cursor tied to unchanged criteria. Sort defaults to id_asc; name_asc and name_desc compare names case-insensitively with ID ascending ties.
tools.name: lists_list

tools.description: Read reminders filtered by account/list IDs, completion, flags, deadline presence, numeric priorities, due status and case-insensitive name-or-notes substring. Filters intersect; empty ID arrays match nothing. Supply criteria in filter or as legacy flat inputs, never both. dueFrom and timestamp dueBefore bound deadline instants (inclusive/exclusive). All-day deadlines use midnight in their source zone. Legacy dueOnOrAfter and date-only dueBefore use reporting days; do not mix bound modes. orderBy supports NAME, DUE_DATE, PRIORITY, CREATION_DATE, MODIFICATION_DATE, COMPLETION_DATE with ASC/DESC, nulls last, and ID ascending ties; it takes precedence over sort. Sort defaults to id_asc; priorities use numeric order; absent creation dates sort last, with identifier ascending to break ties. Cursor is opaque, expires after 10 minutes, and requires identical criteria and limit. Optional unavailable values are omitted. Dates retain EventKit components; omitted hours mean date-only and omitted zones mean floating.
tools.name: reminders_search

tools.description: Read one reminder with component and projected dates, Reminders flags, container reference, alert date, alarms and recurrence; returns null when absent. Metadata read failures fail the call.
tools.name: reminders_get
